```sql
-- DATASET 1
-- Tests:
-- 1. Tautological join condition `teaches.ID = teaches.ID` (cross join of instructor and teaches) vs standard join `instructor.ID = teaches.ID`.
-- 2. `JOIN course USING (course_id)` vs `NATURAL JOIN course` (which would also join on dept_name).
-- 3. `SELECT DISTINCT` vs `SELECT ALL` (duplicates generated by multiple sections of the same course).
-- 4. Unmatched rows in `instructor` and `course` (to kill OUTER JOIN mutants).
-- 5. `student` vs `instructor` table confusion.
INSERT INTO department (dept_name, building, budget) VALUES ('Comp. Sci.', 'Taylor', 100000.00);
INSERT INTO department (dept_name, building, budget) VALUES ('Physics', 'Watson', 80000.00);
INSERT INTO department (dept_name, building, budget) VALUES ('History', 'Painter', 50000.00);

INSERT INTO classroom (building, room_number, capacity) VALUES ('Taylor', '3128', 70);
INSERT INTO classroom (building, room_number, capacity) VALUES ('Watson', '100', 50);

INSERT INTO course (course_id, title, dept_name, credits) VALUES ('CS-101', 'Intro to CS', 'Comp. Sci.', 4);
INSERT INTO course (course_id, title, dept_name, credits) VALUES ('PHY-101', 'Physical Principles', 'Physics', 4);
INSERT INTO course (course_id, title, dept_name, credits) VALUES ('HIS-101', 'World History', 'History', 3);

INSERT INTO instructor (ID, name, dept_name, salary) VALUES ('10101', 'Srinivasan', 'Comp. Sci.', 65000.00);
INSERT INTO instructor (ID, name, dept_name, salary) VALUES ('22222', 'Einstein', 'Physics', 95000.00);
INSERT INTO instructor (ID, name, dept_name, salary) VALUES ('32343', 'El Said', 'History', 60000.00);

INSERT INTO section (course_id, sec_id, semester, year, building, room_number, time_slot_id) VALUES ('CS-101', '1', 'Fall', 2017, 'Taylor', '3128', 'A');
INSERT INTO section (course_id, sec_id, semester, year, building, room_number, time_slot_id) VALUES ('CS-101', '2', 'Spring', 2018, 'Taylor', '3128', 'B');
INSERT INTO section (course_id, sec_id, semester, year, building, room_number, time_slot_id) VALUES ('PHY-101', '1', 'Fall', 2017, 'Watson', '100', 'C');
INSERT INTO section (course_id, sec_id, semester, year, building, room_number, time_slot_id) VALUES ('HIS-101', '1', 'Fall', 2017, 'Watson', '100', 'D');

INSERT INTO teaches (ID, course_id, sec_id, semester, year) VALUES ('10101', 'CS-101', '1', 'Fall', 2017);
INSERT INTO teaches (ID, course_id, sec_id, semester, year) VALUES ('10101', 'CS-101', '2', 'Spring', 2018);
INSERT INTO teaches (ID, course_id, sec_id, semester, year) VALUES ('10101', 'PHY-101', '1', 'Fall', 2017);

INSERT INTO student (ID, name, dept_name, tot_cred) VALUES ('99999', 'Zhang', 'Comp. Sci.', 102);
INSERT INTO takes (ID, course_id, sec_id, semester, year, grade) VALUES ('99999', 'HIS-101', '1', 'Fall', 2017, 'A');
```

```sql
-- DATASET 2
-- Tests:
-- 1. Empty `teaches` table with non-empty `instructor`, `course`, and `section` tables.
-- 2. Kills LEFT/RIGHT/FULL OUTER JOIN mutants and queries that bypass `teaches` (e.g., joining `instructor` and `course` directly on `dept_name`, or joining via `section`).
INSERT INTO department (dept_name, building, budget) VALUES ('Biology', 'Watson', 90000.00);

INSERT INTO classroom (building, room_number, capacity) VALUES ('Watson', '120', 40);

INSERT INTO course (course_id, title, dept_name, credits) VALUES ('BIO-101', 'Intro to Biology', 'Biology', 4);

INSERT INTO instructor (ID, name, dept_name, salary) VALUES ('76766', 'Crick', 'Biology', 72000.00);

INSERT INTO section (course_id, sec_id, semester, year, building, room_number, time_slot_id) VALUES ('BIO-101', '1', 'Summer', 2018, 'Watson', '120', 'E');

INSERT INTO student (ID, name, dept_name, tot_cred) VALUES ('12345', 'Shankar', 'Biology', 32);
INSERT INTO takes (ID, course_id, sec_id, semester, year, grade) VALUES ('12345', 'BIO-101', '1', 'Summer', 2018, 'B');
```

```sql
-- DATASET 3
-- Tests:
-- 1. Handling of NULL values in `dept_name` (both in `instructor` and `course`) and `title` (in `course`).
-- 2. Kills mutants that implicitly filter out NULL `dept_name` (e.g., via inner joins on `department` or `instructor.dept_name = course.dept_name`) or filter on `title IS NOT NULL`.
-- 3. Tests ordering / value boundary mutations (salaries near 29000 check, credits=1, varying years/semesters).
INSERT INTO classroom (building, room_number, capacity) VALUES ('Main', '101', 30);

INSERT INTO course (course_id, title, dept_name, credits) VALUES ('GEN-001', NULL, NULL, 1);
INSERT INTO course (course_id, title, dept_name, credits) VALUES ('GEN-002', 'General Studies', NULL, 2);

INSERT INTO instructor (ID, name, dept_name, salary) VALUES ('11111', 'Wu', NULL, 29001.00);
INSERT INTO instructor (ID, name, dept_name, salary) VALUES ('22222', 'Mozart', NULL, 40000.00);

INSERT INTO section (course_id, sec_id, semester, year, building, room_number, time_slot_id) VALUES ('GEN-001', '1', 'Winter', 2000, 'Main', '101', 'F');
INSERT INTO section (course_id, sec_id, semester, year, building, room_number, time_slot_id) VALUES ('GEN-002', '1', 'Spring', 2020, 'Main', '101', 'G');

INSERT INTO teaches (ID, course_id, sec_id, semester, year) VALUES ('11111', 'GEN-001', '1', 'Winter', 2000);
INSERT INTO teaches (ID, course_id, sec_id, semester, year) VALUES ('22222', 'GEN-002', '1', 'Spring', 2020);
```

```sql
-- DATASET 4
-- Tests:
-- 1. Co-teaching scenario (two different instructors teaching the exact same section of a course).
-- 2. Instructor teaching a course in a different department than their own when both have valid non-null departments, while NO instructor shares the course's department.
-- 3. Kills mutants grouping by `course_id` or `sec_id`, and mutants joining `instructor` directly with `course` on `dept_name`.
INSERT INTO department (dept_name, building, budget) VALUES ('Elec. Eng.', 'Taylor', 85000.00);
INSERT INTO department (dept_name, building, budget) VALUES ('Math', 'Painter', 60000.00);
INSERT INTO department (dept_name, building, budget) VALUES ('Music', 'Packard', 40000.00);

INSERT INTO classroom (building, room_number, capacity) VALUES ('Packard', '101', 100);

INSERT INTO course (course_id, title, dept_name, credits) VALUES ('MUS-199', 'Music Video Production', 'Music', 3);

INSERT INTO instructor (ID, name, dept_name, salary) VALUES ('45565', 'Katz', 'Elec. Eng.', 75000.00);
INSERT INTO instructor (ID, name, dept_name, salary) VALUES ('58583', 'Califieri', 'Math', 62000.00);

INSERT INTO section (course_id, sec_id, semester, year, building, room_number, time_slot_id) VALUES ('MUS-199', '1', 'Spring', 2018, 'Packard', '101', 'H');

INSERT INTO teaches (ID, course_id, sec_id, semester, year) VALUES ('45565', 'MUS-199', '1', 'Spring', 2018);
INSERT INTO teaches (ID, course_id, sec_id, semester, year) VALUES ('58583', 'MUS-199', '1', 'Spring', 2018);
```
